intro: Our Adriana bed makes the most of smaller rooms. With hidden storage, durable materials, and a compact frame, it brings lasting comfort and effortless organisation to your space.

features.title: Strong frame for everyday comfort
features.text: Our durable metal frame and particleboard panels offer stable, supportive comfort — designed to handle daily use while keeping your space stylish.

features.title: Decorative trims that elevate your space
features.text: Subtle HDF trims along the headboard and footboard add refined detail, giving your bed a touch of elegance without overpowering your space.

features.title: Underbed storage that keeps clutter away
features.text: A smooth pull-out drawer under the bed offers hidden storage for clothes, bedding, or extras — helping you keep your room tidy and organised.

features.title: Compact design that fits your life
features.text: Designed for smaller rooms, Adriana fits neatly into tighter spaces — giving you full comfort without crowding your room.

features.title: Easy assembly for a stress-free setup
features.text: Knockdown construction makes it easy to assemble or move, so you can set up your bed quickly without professional help.

name: Adriana Single Size Engineered Wood Bed With Pull Out Storage
